title: Blue Bird School Bus Foundation Grants Fight Hunger, Protect Kids and Expand Learning
summary: The Blue Bird School Bus Foundation awarded $60,000 to 11 local nonprofit organizations improving the education, health and safety of Middle Georgia’s children.
body_markdown:
**Macon, Ga. (October 27, 2026) –** The Blue Bird School Bus Foundation, the charitable arm of Blue Bird Corporation (Nasdaq: BLBD), awarded $60,000 to 11 local nonprofit organizations at its Fall Grants Awards event. The grants support the Foundation’s commitment to improving the education, health and safety of Middle Georgia’s children. Recipients are:


- [Backpack Buddies Ministry](https://www.foresthillsmacon.com/backpack-ministry)
- [Central Georgia CASA](https://www.cgcasa.org/)
- [Central Georgia Council, Scouting America](https://www.centralgeorgiacouncil.org/)
- [Crisis Line & Safe House of Central Georgia](https://cl-sh.org/)
- [First Choice Primary Care](https://www.firstchoiceprimarycare.org/)
- [Macon Hope Inc., DBA First Tee Middle Georgia](https://firstteemiddlegeorgia.org/)
- [Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots](https://www.toysfortots.org/)
- [Middle Georgia Community Food Bank](https://mgcfb.org/)
- [Pace Center for Girls](https://www.pacecenter.org/)
- [Ronald McDonald House of Central Georgia](https://rmhccga.org/)
- [The Corporation of Mercer University – Go Baby Go](https://den.mercer.edu/major-milestone-as-mercers-go-baby-go-builds-200th-toy-car-for-children-with-limited-mobility/)


Donations ranged from $2,500 up to $10,000.


“For nearly a century, Blue Bird has carried Georgia’s children safely to school, and our commitment to them extends well beyond the bus stop,” said John Wyskiel, Blue Bird’s president and CEO. “These grants support organizations that feed families, protect vulnerable children and open new doors to learning. Each investment strengthens the communities we call home and helps prepare young people for a healthy, successful future.”


Since its inception in 2015, the Blue Bird School Bus Foundation has donated more than $873,000 in charitable contributions to community organizations, including over 60 Georgia-based nonprofits.


“The Blue Bird School Bus Foundation’s support will help the Central Georgia Council provide hands-on STEM education through Exploring STEM Clubs for middle school students in Macon County, giving them opportunities to explore science, technology, engineering and math in fun and meaningful ways,” said Garrett L. Williams, scout executive of the Central Georgia Council, Scouting America. “The grant will help cover STEM supplies, hands-on projects, and program activities that allow students to learn by doing and see how STEM connects to real-world careers. This support will help us reach more students and inspire them to build the skills, confidence and curiosity they need for their future.”


The event took place on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at Blue Bird’s corporate headquarters in Macon.


***Awardees from 11 local nonprofits gather at Blue Bird headquarters in Macon on Oct. 27, 2026, after receiving a combined $60,000 from the Blue Bird School Bus Foundation, the charitable arm of Blue Bird Corporation.***


###


### **About Blue Bird School Bus Foundation Inc.** ****


The Blue Bird School Bus Foundation Inc. is a Georgia nonprofit corporation with the mission to promote education, health, and safety for children in the state of Georgia. Established in 2015, the Foundation supports organizations that directly benefit school-age children under 19 years old as well as organizations which directly support disadvantaged communities. For more information, visit[https://bbsbf.org](https://bbsbf.org/) .


### **About Blue Bird Corporation** ****


Blue Bird (NASDAQ: BLBD) is recognized as a technology leader and innovator of school buses since its founding in 1927. Our dedicated team members design, engineer and manufacture school buses with a singular focus on safety, reliability, and durability. School buses carry the most precious cargo in the world – 25 million children twice a day – making them the most trusted mode of student transportation. The company is the proven leader in low- and zero-emission school buses with more than 25,000 propane, natural gas, and electric powered buses sold. Blue Bird is transforming the student transportation industry through cleaner energy solutions. For more information on Blue Bird’s complete product and service portfolio, visit[www.blue-bird.com](https://www.blue-bird.com/) .
